title: Pastoral
identity: Elliott Carter’s *Pastoral* was composed in 1940 and revised in 1982, with a listed duration of ten minutes. Carter’s official catalog lists an alternate E-flat alto saxophone and piano version as well as English-horn and piano, clarinet and piano, viola and piano, and an English-horn version with marimba and strings. The official page’s two recordings are English-horn performances; a separate saxophone recording is listed on Spotify.

evidence.claim: Composer’s official catalog gives date/revision, ten-minute duration, alternate versions including E-flat alto saxophone and piano, and English-horn recording listings.
Digital music service lists a 9:20 saxophone recording of Pastoral by Kyle Horch and Pamela Lidiard on *Anglosax*.

review_focus: Inference: compare the published E-flat alto version with the composer’s listed English-horn origin and inspect the solo part’s range and phrasing; score not inspected.
collection_flag: Alternate saxophone version of a work that the composer’s site identifies as originally for English horn and piano; the sax version is listed at ten minutes.

listening.description: Pastoral, saxophone and piano, performed by Kyle Horch and Pamela Lidiard, track length 9:20.
listening.verification: track and performers cataloged; not auditioned

gaps: No score preview or notation inspection; saxophone-specific demands unknown.
